name: Nikau
source:
Job: Lifeguard

Nikau is a competitive surfer, who moonlights as the hottest lifeguard you've ever seen! He hopes to get a sponsorship and go pro. He's also fiercely proud of being Maori.

He comes across brash and dickish, but a guy who saves lives can't be all bad, right?

[From [url=https://soulsoftea.itch.io/baraboarders]itch.io[/url]]
